s: sTEryye । Kanane । hiMsAyAm । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-paraM-sTEryye akaM-KananAdO sakaManiw .) KAyati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: sTEryye aka॰ Kanane hiMsAyAYca saka॰ BvA॰ para॰ aniw । KAyati aKAsIt caKO ।
m: खै cl. 1. P. खायति, to make firm, Dhātup. xxii, 15; to be firm or steady, ib.; to strike, injure, kill, ib.; (derived fr. खायते Pass. of √ खन्) to dig, ib.; to mourn, sorrow, ib.

v: tri॰ Kila + caturarTyAM pakzA॰ Pak । KilanirvfttAdO ।

खैलायन m. patr. fr. खेड, g. अश्वादि (Kāś.)
खैलिक mfn. supplementary, additional, added afterwards, RV. AnuvAnukr. 39.
खैमखा f. (onomat.) ‘croaker’, N. of a female frog, AV. iv, 15, 15

v: pu॰ Ke AkASe karttavyaH maKaH svArTe aR । AkASakarttavye yajYaBede “KaRvaKAi KEmaKAi maDye taduriH” aTa॰ 4 । 15 । 15 । KEmaKe ityatra stoBayogAt agne ityatra agnAi iti tadrUpam ।
